item.title:
The Office of Civil Defense (OCD) joined Arise Philippines' El Niño Forum yesterday at Megatrade Hall in Ortigas City.
Civil Defense Deputy Administrator Assistant Secretary Cesar Idio delivered a message of support, emphasizing the importance of strengthening preparedness and anticipatory actions, enhancing government interventions, and fostering collaboration among various sectors and the general public to mitigate the impacts of El Niño.
Meanwhile, OCD Spokesperson Junie Castillo discussed the government's preparedness and response measures for the impacts of El Niño. He also highlighted the importance of collaboration among the general public, government, and private sectors in addressing the threats and challenges posed by El Niño.
The OCD also set up an exhibit booth featuring various disaster risk reduction and management (DRRM) equipment, tools, and resources used in its various operations and initiatives.
#CivilDefensePH #ServingTheNation #BagongPilipinas #PanatagAngMayAl - Facebook
